notes: All three PEPlife2 values verified against the Introduction: K17F 50 s i.v., LIT01-196 28 min i.v. and 156 min s.c. ONE SEQUENCE, THREE LABELS SPANNING 187-FOLD. PEPlife2 assigns K17F and LIT01-196 the identical string KFRRQRPRLSHLGPMPF, so this study contributes three records with the same input and half-lives of 50 s, 28 min and 156 min. Two separate effects are invisible in that representation: LIT01-196 is K17F with a FLUOROCARBON CHAIN added to its N-terminus ('the original chemical addition of a fluorocarbon chain to the N-terminal part of K17F'), which accounts for the 34-fold jump from 50 s to 28 min; and the further 5.6-fold jump to 156 min is a ROUTE effect, i.v. versus s.c., which PEPlife2 also does not record. Note the half-lives are reported in the Introduction as prior results rather than measured in this paper, which is a blood-pressure pharmacology study; no dose, group size or bioanalytical method for the PK is given in the body.
